items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: on one of the minstrel shows we were on, the man's name was Blind Denslow

ctx.x: No, you never do. But see, when you're that young, somehow you catalog these things and you do remember them, you know. And I don't know if I told you about -- there was a team -- someone would remember -- on one of the minstrel shows we were on, the man's name was Blind Denslow, and now I never thought I would ever remember his name again, but just in talking to you -- he was a blind man that performed on stage, you know, and he used to break the show up. And his wife would have to lead him to the wings, you…
That's pretty unusual. I've never heard of a blind dancer.
